xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) had issued an order dated September 16, 2025 for payment of Rs. 2,45,511 (Rupees Two Lakh Forty Five Thousand Five Hundred Eleven only) with respect to compounding contraventions of certain provisions of the Foreign Exchange Management Transfer or lssue any Foreign security Regulations,2004, as amended from time to time.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav:
The violation pertains to (i) Undertaking disinvestment from a foreign wholly owned subsidiary (later converted to Joint Venture), namely Aditya lnfotech Asia pte Ltd., Singapore (AlAPL) without undertaking valuation based on audited financial statements and
(ii) writing off loan and interest receivables without obtention of approval from the Reserve Bank of India amounting to contravention of Regulations 16 (1) (iii) and 16 (1) (iv respectively, of Foreign Exchange Management Transfer or Issue any Foreign security Regulations,2004, as amended from time to time.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: The financial impact on the Company is limited to the extent of Rs. 2,45,511 (Rupees Two Lakh Forty Five Thousand Five Hundred Eleven only), Compounding fee paid by the Company. There is no impact on operations or other activities of the Company.
